newsitem.title: NIGERIA: At least 18 die celebrating new Nigerian states.
newsitem.headline: At least 18 die celebrating new Nigerian states.

text.p: At least 18 Nigerians died in road accidents as they celebrated the creation of six new states by military ruler General Sani Abacha, newspapers reported on Wednesday.

The Punch said 12 people died in two crashes in the new northern states of Gombe and Zamfara. The Vanguard said six others died when their vehicle somersaulted from a convoy of others celebrating creation of central Nassarawa state.
Abacha on Tuesday created six new states, making a total of 36, as the next step on his timetable to restore civilian rule by October 1998.
"There should be no festivities and jubilation or ill-feelings among communities over the new states," he said.
Nigeria's states have a substantial degree of autonomy. The six created were drawn from 72 requests made by communities in different parts of the ethnically divided country.
